posts.name: Soup CLI
posts.tagline: Fine-tune an 8B LLM on a 4 GB laptop GPU
posts.description: LoRA keeps the base model frozen: read, never written. So Soup keeps it in system RAM and streams it into the GPU one decoder layer at a time. Peak VRAM becomes one layer instead of the whole model. Measured on an RTX 3050 Laptop 4 GB: Llama-3.1-8B trains at 119.6 tok/s in 3.32 GB peak. One YAML, one command. SFT, DPO, GRPO, KTO, plus eval, gating and export. Apache-2.0. Every number is published, including the ones I measured and threw away.

By implementing strict process management and native OS credential storage, MCPanel eliminates plaintext API keys and orphaned background processes.

posts.name: mdworkspace
posts.tagline: Build local-first workspaces from markdown, assets & tasks
posts.description: mdworkspace Desktop is a local-first Windows workspace for agencies, operators, researchers, creators, and technical teams. Start with markdown, then add structured blocks, imports, local assets, Pro workflows, and export-ready output as projects grow.

posts.name: NijiCAD
posts.tagline: A simple and lightweight 2D CAD
posts.description: NijiCAD takes a simple approach to 2D CAD. It focuses on the essentials of drafting without the complexity often found in traditional CAD software. It combines a familiar CAD interface with command-line and keyboard-driven workflows for fast, efficient drawing. With DXF support, layers, dimensions, hatches, and web and Windows desktop versions, NijiCAD is designed for everyday 2D drafting. We’re launching NijiCAD on Product Hunt to introduce it to more people and hear your feedback.

posts.name: StylixAI
posts.tagline: Redesign any website with natural-language prompts
posts.description: Make every website feel like it was designed for you. StylixAI lets anyone redesign any webpage using natural-language instructions. Change themes, colors, fonts, spacing, layouts, and borders or hide distracting elements. Apply changes to one element, a section, or the entire page. Choose from 97+ themes and 78+ fonts, then save the design as a site rule that automatically reapplies whenever you return.

posts.name: Recallity
posts.tagline: Find your knowledge gaps, then drill them with real recall
posts.description: Recallity is an AI spaced-repetition app for students cramming for exams. Upload any material (files, photo or from your computer/laptop), brain-dump what you already remember, and Recallity maps your knowledge gaps concept by concept, then drills only those with real recall in your own words. Exam Mode compresses your review schedule to your exam date and shows if you're on track. Every card links to the exact source passage, so you can verify it. Free to start on iPhone.

posts.name: Flairo
posts.tagline: Find companies that need you. Reach them automatically.
posts.description: Paste your website. Flairo finds companies showing relevant buying signals, identifies the right decision-maker, and drafts personalized LinkedIn and email outreach. You approve it; Flairo sends and follows up automatically.

posts.tagline: Give me your problem and see build it in 7 days
posts.description: Describe a real business problem in plain English—I'll scope it, quote a fixed price within 24 hours, and build the website, mobile app, automation, or IoT solution in days, not months. Clients get a unique tracking ID (PTP-XXXXXX) to monitor 6-stage live progress from scoping to delivery.

posts.name: FitOdds — lose weight, keep muscle

posts.description: FitOdds turns a GLP-1 journey into today's protein, strength, weight, and body-composition plan designed to help protect muscle.

It even tracks whether ChatGPT & Perplexity cite you. Multi-model (GPT-4o, Claude, Gemini). Free plan, no card, live in 5 minutes.

posts.name: Theseus Guard

posts.description: Theseus Guard is a stateful AI governance platform built for the Agentic Internet. Unlike stateless guardrails that evaluate interactions in isolation, it tracks agent identity and behavior across multi-turn sessions, nested agents, and lifecycle changes. It combines real-time runtime enforcement, behavioral drift detection, and tamper-evident cryptographic provenance—so enterprises can govern autonomous AI continuously, enforce policies at inference time, and prove what happened.

posts.name: Veritronyx

posts.description: Veritronyx turns AI governance and EU AI Act readiness into an operational workflow. Inventory AI systems, classify risk, assign controls, collect evidence, manage CAPAs and changes, track vendors, training and reviews - all in one platform. Unlike consultant-heavy compliance projects, Veritronyx is built for continuous, practical governance teams can actually operate.

posts.name: LeadForge AI
posts.tagline: Find leads, run outbound, close deals. No tool stack.
posts.description: Stop stitching together a prospecting tool, a sequencer, a warm-up service, and a CRM. LeadForge AI is an end-to-end B2B outbound workspace: Apollo-style filtered lead search, a real CRM with visual pipeline, multichannel campaigns (email, LinkedIn, AI voicemail), and built-in mailbox warm-up — all in one app, starting at $15/mo. Built for founders, SDRs, and small agencies who want search-to-pipeline without a 5-tool stack.

posts.name: SAND: Photo Browser
posts.tagline: Browse any folder like Apple Photos, without importing
posts.description: SAND is a native macOS photo browser that lets you browse photos directly from folders, external drives, SD cards, iPhones, Android phones, and digital cameras without importing. Enjoy familiar Years, Months, and Days views, secure Hidden folders with Touch ID, beautiful themes, and privacy focused tools. Everything stays local, so your photos remain exactly where they are.

posts.name: Panzoe Technologies
posts.tagline: One AI for Life!
posts.description: Panzoe has evolved. We've redesigned the experience, improved performance, introduced interactive AI Daily Briefings, expanded to 25 AI assistants, added an AI Brain with shared memory, and continue adding new integrations. Instead of juggling dozens of AI tools, Panzoe brings everything together in one intelligent platform.

posts.name: Suprnova
posts.tagline: A Laravel-inspired web framework for Rust
posts.description: Suprnova is a full-stack Rust web framework that brings Laravel's developer experience to Tokio. Eloquent-style ORM, type-checked routing, auth, queues, scheduling, mail, WebSockets, and Inertia frontends with TypeScript types generated from your Rust structs. Everything compiles to a single binary. No PHP-FPM, no opcache, no separate runtime. MIT licensed, 100+ chapters of docs, production ready.

posts.name: Stufeze
posts.tagline: Plan less. Travel more.
posts.description: Plan your next trip in one tap🌍 No matter where you are in the world, Stufeze creates personalized, day-wise travel itineraries based on your destination, trip duration, and travel style.

posts.name: Sinanverse — AI Ebook Store
posts.tagline: AI-generated ebooks published automatically every 5 hours
posts.description: An AI-powered ebook store that automatically generates and publishes new self-help and productivity ebooks every 5 hours using Claude AI and n8n automation. No manual work — the system runs 24/7 and keeps adding new titles. All ebooks are $9.99 and instantly downloadable.

posts.name: SQLestev
posts.tagline: Render live ER diagrams just by typing SQL code
posts.description: You write standard MySQL or PostgreSQL code on one side, and a live entity-relationship diagram renders it on the other—kept in sync as you type. No proprietary syntax, no manual drawing. The diagram is just another view of your code. Oftentimes, diagrams become bloated and it's difficult to use the visual. A different approach was implemented this time: a user enters the Brainstorm mode and is isolated from all tables except for the target table and all relational tables connected to it.

posts.name: Yumi AI Assistant
posts.tagline: Your AI employee that works for your business 24/7
posts.description: Yumi AI is a ready-to-use AI business assistant that works 24/7. Businesses can customize Yumi with their own services, information, and knowledge. It works as a standalone assistant or can be integrated into an existing website — no website required.

posts.name: Van Helsin

Built for people who want AI to deliver complete experiences, not just isolated answers.

Built with AI-assisted development, focused on doing one thing well: offline listening.
